grammarName.en: Prepositions of place (next to, opposite, behind, in front of)
grammarName.ru: Предлоги места (next to, opposite, behind, in front of)

scenario: The office has a small car park. The best spot is next to the entrance, and Den parks there every day. Today Valery arrives first and parks his car in that spot, opposite the entrance. Den arrives later and is angry: 'That spot is mine! Your car is in front of my car!' Valery says calmly: 'The rules do not say it is your spot. Today my car is next to the door.' Kate parks behind the building and walks in. She says: 'Boys, stop fighting. I will make a schedule. You park there on Mondays, and you on Tuesdays.' Keep it warm and light. Use prepositions of place a lot: next to, opposite, behind, in front of, between.
